source._comment: SD SoS posts weekly (Fridays) statewide absentee statistics with a party breakout on its '2026 Weekly Absentee Numbers' page, one section per election. No county breakdown is published, so SD is statewide-only (counties empty). sd_update.py reads the section whose heading contains section_match. As of 2026-09-24 only the Primary and Run-off sections were posted.
source._standin: Until the official source posts (or is wired), the connector writes a UF Election Lab stand-in via scripts/lab_standin.py (US.csv + SD_county.csv when available; unaltered, attributed, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0). Official data replaces it automatically.
